TRIMAW-STRIKE_TRIMAW.title: Strike
TRIMAW-DEFEND_TRIMAW.title: Defend
TRIMAW-DOUBLE_AXE.title: Double Axe
TRIMAW-HUNGER_PANGS.title: Hunger Pangs
TRIMAW-HUNGER_PANGS.description:
[gold]Prep[/gold] the last [color=#ff9047]Morsel[/color] you prepped.
[gold]Prep[/gold] a random [color=#ff9047]Morsel[/color].
TRIMAW-BANG_BUMP_POW.title: Bang, Bump, Pow!
TRIMAW-BANG_BUMP_POW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
If this kills an enemy, [gold]Prep[/gold] [color=#ff9047]Bread[/color] {BreadAmount:diff()} times.
TRIMAW-BREAKFAST.title: Breakfast
TRIMAW-BUBBLE_CRISIS.title: Bubble Crisis
TRIMAW-CANNONBALL.title: Cannonball!
TRIMAW-CHOMP.title: Chomp
TRIMAW-DADADADADA.title: Dadadadada!
TRIMAW-DADADADADA.description:
Whenever you play an Attack this turn, draw a card.
Add {Dart:diff()} {Dart:[gold]Dart[/gold]|[gold]Darts[/gold]} into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TRIMAW-DARTBOARD.title: Dartboard
TRIMAW-DARTBOARD.description: At the start of your turn, add a [gold]Dart[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TRIMAW-EUNECTES.title: Eunectes
TRIMAW-FLUSH_OUT.title: Flush Out
TRIMAW-GRIND.title: Grind
TRIMAW-MILKCAP.title: Milkcap
TRIMAW-PLUCK.title: Pluck
TRIMAW-REALLY_DRY_BREAD.title: Really Dry Bread
TRIMAW-ROUGHHOUSE.title: Roughhouse
TRIMAW-ROUGHHOUSE.description:
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
Put {Cards:diff()} random 1{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TRIMAW-TAKE_AIM.title: Take Aim
TRIMAW-DART.title: Dart
TRIMAW-DART.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you don't have any [gold]Aim[/gold], gain {AimPower:diff()} [gold]Aim[/gold].
TRIMAW-BARRENS_TEQUILA.title: Barrens Tequila
TRIMAW-BARRENS_TEQUILA.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Transform all Attacks in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into random [purple]Super Special[/purple] Attacks.
TRIMAW-BLOOD_CURD.title: Blood Curd
TRIMAW-BLOOD_CURD.description: Fill your [gold]Hand[/gold] with random {IfUpgraded:show:Upgraded |}[gold]Ironclad[/gold] cards. They gain [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
TRIMAW-BOX_OF_TRUFFLES.title: Box of Truffles
TRIMAW-BOX_OF_TRUFFLES.description:
Randomly [gold]Imagine[/gold] a [color=#50d6d6]Figment[/color]
or add a [purple]Super Special[/purple] Skill
to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Repeat this effect {Repeat:diff()} {Repeat:plural:more time|more times}.
TRIMAW-BOBS_BEER.title: Bob's Beer
TRIMAW-BOBS_BEER.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Randomize the cost of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] this turn, from 0 to {Energy:diff()}.
TRIMAW-BONE_APPLE_TEA.title: Bone Apple Tea
TRIMAW-BONE_APPLE_TEA.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
[gold]Prep[/gold] [color=#ff9047]Shrooms[/color] for each Attack drawn and [color=#ff9047]Bread[/color] for each other card drawn.
TRIMAW-BYRDOMELET.title: Byrdomelet
TRIMAW-BYRDOMELET.description: Gain {AimPower:diff()} [gold]Aim[/gold]. If an enemy intends to attack, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
TRIMAW-CARAMEL_CANDIES.title: Caramel Candies
TRIMAW-CARAMEL_CANDIES.description: Transform 1{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show: and [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]|} into [purple]Glammed[/purple] copies.
TRIMAW-CARGIRL.title: Cargirl
TRIMAW-CRAB_PORRIDGE.title: Crab Porridge
TRIMAW-CRAB_PORRIDGE.description: Put the {Cards:plural:costliest card|{Cards:diff()} costliest cards} from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. {Cards:plural:It's|They're} free to play this turn.
TRIMAW-FAIRY_RING.title: Fairy Ring
TRIMAW-GUMMY_DUMPLING.title: Gummy Dumpling
TRIMAW-HONEY_BISCUIT.title: Honey Biscuit
TRIMAW-HONEY_BISCUIT.description: Transform {IfUpgraded:show:a random|the costliest} card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into a [purple]Polished[/purple] copy.
TRIMAW-HOT_SAUCE.title: Hot Sauce
TRIMAW-INSANITY_PEPPER.title: Insanity Pepper
TRIMAW-KEBAB.title: Kebab
TRIMAW-KEBAB.description:
[gold]Imagine[/gold] [color=#50d6d6]Vulcan[/color].
Put {Cards:diff()} random {Cards:plural:Attack|Attacks} from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TRIMAW-MD_PEPPER.title: M.D. Pepper
TRIMAW-MD_PEPPER.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}. Gain 1 [gold]Clarity[/gold] for each unenchanted card drawn.
TRIMAW-NO1_SHIO_RAMEN.title: No.1 Shio Ramen
TRIMAW-NO1_SHIO_RAMEN.description:
Put ALL 1{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show:
They're free to play this turn.|}
TRIMAW-SHAVED_ICE.title: Shaved Ice
TRIMAW-SHAVED_ICE.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
You cannot draw additional cards this turn.
TRIMAW-SLUG_SPREAD.title: Slug Spread
TRIMAW-SLUG_SPREAD.description: Add a random [purple]Really Heavy[/purple] {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Upgraded[/gold] |}Attack into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TRIMAW-TACO_DOSSOLEADO.title: Taco Dossoleado
TRIMAW-TACO_DOSSOLEADO.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Add a random {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Upgraded[/gold] |}Attack with cost equal to your Energy into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TRIMAW-URSUS_BIG_BREAD.title: Ursus Big Bread
TRIMAW-VILLAGE_POT.title: Village Pot
TRIMAW-JUNK_FOOD.title: Junk Food
TRIMAW-SANDBOX.title: Sandbox
TRIMAW-SANDBOX_B.title: Sandbox B
